representation_rules.unknown_answer_ids: Reject the entire submission as in v3.0. Known-ID-only scoring is a separately labeled diagnostic, never the revision score.
representation_rules.units: USD million, USD millions, USD_million, USD_millions: case/space/underscore insensitive; no rescaling.
representation_rules.periods: Case and whitespace/underscore formatting only; no missing date, quarter, year or current/prior inference.
representation_rules.evidence: Require file/table/row/full quote; text is an alias for quote if no conflicting quote. Accept unique manifest basename or workspace-relative path. Ignore extra metadata; conflicting core aliases fail. Pipes are table separators, not content.
representation_rules.certificate_endpoints: Canonical {ranks,top_two}, or a complete issuer->numeric score map, or ordered nonempty tie groups. Derive ranks/top_two solely from submitted values/groups. A flat top-two list is incomplete and is not expanded.
representation_rules.certificate_crossings: A/B and B/A denote the same equality root; conflicting duplicate pairs fail.
representation_rules.certificate_extensions: Keep exact required certificate keys and issuer maps; never fill missing ranks, robust pairs, leave-one-out entries or dates. Optional endpoint values may be omitted only after they independently reproduce the supplied ranks/top_two.
representation_rules.algebra: Exact polynomial cancellation after original denominator-domain checks; never cancel a policy-domain pole. Use reduced forms for derived endpoints and certificates.
representation_rules.score: Original group weights and all-checks-per-root budgets retained. Missing or incorrect substantive answers still fail their roots.
